Spaces to assess

Insulation choices depend on where the material will go.

Access, assembly, moisture and project stage all affect the recommended scope.

The attic needs attention

Existing insulation, roof assembly and access need review before adding material.

A crawl space feels damp

Walls are open for construction

Comfort differences can prompt a closer look at insulation and air movement.

Questions

Before you book

Can spray foam be added to an existing home?

Sometimes. Access, existing materials and the building assembly need to be reviewed first.

Do I need to remove old insulation?

That depends on its condition, type and the planned application. The estimate will state any removal work.

Can the home be occupied during installation?

Project access and reentry instructions depend on the scope and products used. We explain them before scheduling.

Can you insulate a pole barn or shop?

Yes. Tell us how the building is used and whether walls or roof surfaces are open.
